associations.rationale: The type supplies a linear map for each quiver arrow between named vertex spaces, but it does not display that the map is the restriction of the one-edge operator.
The type returns a quiver representation from the module context, but its vertex spaces and restricted one-edge arrow formulas are elided in the opaque result.
The type only returns a submodule for each vertex and does not display the claimed identification with p_iV.
